Despite having a confirmed appointment time, I had to wait almost 50 minutes while holding my baby. Adult patients were being called in before me, and it was completely unclear how the schedule and appointments were being managed.

I am very disappointed with the attitude and the overall organisation of the service. Our vaccination appointments have also been rescheduled several times, which creates additional difficulties for us as new parents.

I am sorry to hear that you had to wait some time for your appointment which had been rearranged a few times.  Unfortunately, we have had some unplanned staff absence.  We covered it as best we could with locums, however sometimes locums run behind due to being new to a surgery.  

Whilst this information does not excuse the lateness and rescheduling of your appointment, I am hoping that it has highlighted that sometimes despite doing our best, things can go off plan.

I am sorry the situation caused you discomfort and pain.  If you would like any more information or would like to discuss it in further, please get in contact with me.

Alex - Practice Manager

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review.   I am saddened to read that you feel our service has deteriorated since the Covid 19 pandemic.

General practice has changed quite significantly since the pandemic and whilst we do encourage the use of online services, we appreciate that this is not for everyone.   Our telephones lines are open between 8am and 6pm Monday to Friday and our practice door is open for those patients who prefer to make an enquiry at the front desk.  GP appointments are telephone consultations in the first instance with face to face being offered if required.  However, if patients feel a face to face is more suitable then this can be accommodated.
